hebrewText: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת אֶחָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֣ף אַחֲרָ֔י/ו דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יַּדְבֵּ֥ק אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/הַ֥ר הַ/גִּלְעָֽד

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))
tokens.kjv: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
tokens.kjv: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r).

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).

tokens.bdb: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
tokens.ptLiteralWord: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.explanation: seven ; also  seven times; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: seven ; also  seven times; by implication

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.

tokens.bdb: properly, to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere; figuratively, to catch by pursuit
tokens.kjv: abide fast, cleave (fast together), follow close (hard after), be joined (together), keep (fast), overtake, pursue hard, stick, take.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites
